mobbin:aa3e5e62-1c1e-4740-bd23-fba061be2.summary: Admin opens Workspace Scorecards with nothing listed yet, starts Experience with a required description, adds a 1-5 rating question, and opens the type menu (1-5 versus Yes/No) with Create enabled.
steps: Workspace Scorecards: No Scorecards and New Scorecard
Untitled Scorecard: required Description; Create disabled
Titled Experience: Description empty; Create disabled
Description 'Overall meeting experience'; still Add Question only
Empty Question block with 1-5 Rating preview
Question filled: 'Did the meeting feel productive…'
Type menu open: 1-5 Rating versus Yes / No
steal: A workspace-scoped library shows 'No Scorecards' before any exist (screen 1).
Create stays disabled until description and a question exist (screens 2-5).
Per-item type list limited to 1-5 Rating or Yes/No (screen 7).
A reusable workspace scorecard, not buried inside one meeting (Scorecards in the side menu).
avoid: Only two response types (screen 7) is too thin for clinical rubrics with multi-point competencies.
mobbin:aa3e5e62-1c1e-4740-bd23-fba061be2.fit: Scenario manager: extend the cut-down checklist editor as a shared workspace rubric library (checklist can live beside scenarios, not only inside SCE tabs).

mobbin:36d2c1e1-60fa-49f5-af4c-419966039.summary: Admin edits Workspace Meetings defaults: auto-record all meetings (member-as-organizer), access/link defaults, languages, recap recipients, and notification switches, with 'Workspace updated' messages.
steps: Defaults: Don't auto record any meetings
Auto record all meetings plus organizer checkbox; short message
Language multi-select open under access area
Full defaults: access, link, languages, recap section
Recap to team domain; comment notify On; duplication On
Recap set; comment/duplication Off; short message
steal: Workspace auto-record default list over meeting-type categories plus an organizer-only checkbox (screens 1-2).
Admin lock icons on auto-record, access and link defaults (screens 1-5).
Meeting recap emails as a separate recipient policy (screens 6-7).
A 'Workspace updated' message after each change (screens 2, 4, 7).
avoid: Org-global Defaults for new workspace members (all screens) are not per-scenario-template automation like Essentials phase auto-record.
mobbin:36d2c1e1-60fa-49f5-af4c-419966039.fit: Scenario manager: nearby to SCE scheduling auto-record/announcements: steal meeting-type filters and locks, but scope is workspace-global, not per-scenario.
